panels.visual: Earmack's head snaps up, her eyes wide with shock and recognition at the name Nizack. Her hands twist in her lap. Around her, the company exchanges knowing glances - they have encountered this name before.
panels.dialogue: Earmack: "Where have you heard that name?"

panels.visual: Earmack describes Karishkir, her voice shaking. In the shadows behind her, a vision of the werewolf queen seems to form - beautiful and terrible, perhaps twenty-five summers, but with a voice that hurts to hear. The company listens in grim silence.
panels.dialogue: Earmack: "She was beautiful and terrible. Her voice... it hurts to hear."
panels.narration: Nizack is one of her lovers. Drekhlo. And the third - Ahad, the Khan of the Nine Skulls.

panels.visual: Tall panel: Hind rises to take command, her presence filling the tent. She wraps Earmack in a cloak of her own - a gesture of protection. Behind her, the company prepares to move. Giovanni, Gan, and Eskil will take the girl to Abu-Rayhan's house. Lueduo and Bansi will find Sadia. The mission has changed.
panels.dialogue: Hind: "Gan, Giovanni, Eskil - take the girl to Abu-Rayhan's house. Raven, Bansi - find Sadia."
